lines.text: Fancy, and a bit too proud.
This coffee shop is so bougie.

data.mean: Fancy, and a bit too proud.
data.define: Liking expensive or fancy things, sometimes in a showy way.

example.text: This coffee shop is so bougie.

misuse.text: Don't call your host 'bougie' at dinner.
misuse.why: It can sound snobbish and rude.

native.tip: “bougie” = 고급스러운 척하는. 예문: “This coffee shop is so bougie.”
